memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: “Let all that you do be done in love.” ( 1 Corinthians 16:14)

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
Love is the language God speaks, the rhythm creation responds to, and the mysterious power that reaches the human soul even without words.
Love breaks down walls of division, wipes away tears, binds up wounds, and rebuilds what hatred tore apart.
A small penguin, an innocent sea creature, swims nearly 5,000 kilometers every year to thank the man who saved its life demonstrating how deep and loyal true love can be. If such a tiny creature can travel thousands of miles out of gratitude, how much more must we run toward the God who saved our souls from eternal death!
How fervently should we seek the Savior who gave His own life for us! Jesus did not merely teach love, He revealed love: He touched the untouchable lepers, healed the sick, comforted the broken, forgave the guilty, and embraced the forgotten.
The world may misunderstand your words, but nobody can misunderstand the pure love of Christ flowing through your life.
Beloved Servant of Christ,
Let your actions preach louder than your voice today, because the language of love will one day be understood by every heart.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: “Where there is love, there is true life.” — Mahatma Gandhi

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text:
Lord, fill my heart with the mighty power of Your love. Let my words and my life reveal Your compassionate heart to everyone I meet today.
Make me a true witness of Your mercy and grace. Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: May the love of Christ overflow through you today.
May your life become an instrument that softens hardened hearts for the glory of God.
